title: DevOps Engineer roadmap
summary: A practical path to solidify core DevOps fundamentals and build a portfolio that showcases automation, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code. By the end you’ll be ready to land a role or win freelance contracts.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Strengthen the operating-system and version-control base needed for any automation work.

milestones.title: Linux command fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can navigate the shell, manage files, processes and services confidently.

tasks.title: Read Linux filesystem overview
tasks.description: Study the directory hierarchy and common file locations on the official Linux Documentation Project.

tasks.title: Practice file permissions
tasks.description: Create files, change owners and permissions, and verify results with ls -l.

tasks.title: Set up a bash alias script
tasks.description: Write a .bashrc snippet that adds useful shortcuts for git and docker commands.

tasks.title: Reflect on shell shortcuts
tasks.description: Write a short note on which shortcuts saved you time and why.

milestones.title: Git workflow and CI basics
milestones.outcome: You can manage branches, resolve conflicts, and configure a simple CI pipeline.

tasks.title: Complete Git branching tutorial on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Follow the interactive lessons and create a feature branch, merge, and rebase.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions for a hello-world repo
tasks.description: Create a workflow file that runs lint and unit tests on push.

tasks.title: Practice resolving a merge conflict
tasks.description: Intentionally create conflicting changes and resolve them using the command line.

tasks.title: Connect with a DevOps community
tasks.description: Join the r/devops subreddit and introduce yourself, asking for CI best-practice tips.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Learn containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code tools.

milestones.title: Docker fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can containerize an application, write Dockerfiles, and manage images.

tasks.title: Read Docker engine docs on Docker.com
tasks.description: Focus on image layers, Dockerfile syntax, and best practices.

tasks.title: Build a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Node app
tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile that compiles and runs the app in a minimal image.

tasks.title: Practice container networking
tasks.description: Run two containers and connect them with a user-defined bridge network.

tasks.title: Reflect on image size reductions
tasks.description: Compare sizes before and after multi-stage builds and note optimizations.

milestones.title: Kubernetes basics
milestones.outcome: You can deploy workloads, expose services, and perform basic troubleshooting on a cluster.

tasks.title: Follow the Kubernetes basics tutorial on Kubernetes.io
tasks.description: Complete the interactive labs that cover pods, deployments, and services.

tasks.title: Deploy a sample app with a Deployment and Service
tasks.description: Use kubectl to apply YAML manifests for a hello-world container.

tasks.title: Practice scaling and rolling update
tasks.description: Scale the deployment to 3 replicas and perform a rolling update to a new image version.

tasks.title: Connect with a local K8s meetup group
tasks.description: Find a virtual meetup on Meetup.com and attend the next session.

milestones.title: Infrastructure as code with Terraform
milestones.outcome: You can provision cloud resources declaratively and manage state safely.

tasks.title: Read Terraform getting started guide on HashiCorp docs
tasks.description: Understand providers, resources, and state files.

tasks.title: Write Terraform config for an AWS EC2 instance
tasks.description: Create main.tf, variables.tf and apply the plan using the CLI.

tasks.title: Practice using remote state backend
tasks.description: Configure an S3 bucket with DynamoDB locking for state storage.

tasks.title: Reflect on idempotence benefits
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how Terraform ensures consistent environments.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate end-to-end DevOps pipelines.

milestones.title: CI/CD pipeline for a web app
milestones.outcome: You can automatically build, test and deploy a sample web service on each commit.

tasks.title: Select a simple Flask app from GitHub
tasks.description: Fork a minimal Flask repository to your own account.

tasks.title: Create GitHub Actions workflow with Docker build
tasks.description: Define jobs that lint, test, build a Docker image and push to Docker Hub.

tasks.title: Practice deploying to a free Kubernetes sandbox
tasks.description: Use a free K8s playground (e.g., Play with Kubernetes) to apply the image via a Deployment.

tasks.title: Reflect on pipeline failures and fixes
tasks.description: Document any errors encountered and how you resolved them.

milestones.title: Containerised multi-service app
milestones.outcome: You can orchestrate several containers with Docker Compose and Kubernetes.

tasks.title: Design a three-service app (frontend, API, DB)
tasks.description: Sketch the service responsibilities and communication flow.

tasks.title: Write Docker Compose file for local dev
tasks.description: Define services, networks, and volumes to run the stack on a laptop.

tasks.title: Translate Compose to Kubernetes manifests
tasks.description: Create Deployment and Service YAMLs for each component and apply them to a cluster.

tasks.title: Connect with a peer for code review
tasks.description: Share your repo on dev.to and request feedback on architecture.

milestones.title: Terraform-defined infrastructure
milestones.outcome: You can provision a full environment (VPC, subnets, compute) using IaC.

tasks.title: Plan a Terraform project for a VPC and EC2
tasks.description: Define resources for networking and a web server instance.

tasks.title: Build the Terraform configuration and apply
tasks.description: Run terraform init, plan, and apply to create the resources on AWS free tier.

tasks.title: Practice destroying and recreating safely
tasks.description: Use terraform destroy and then re-apply, noting state handling.

tasks.title: Reflect on cost-optimization measures
tasks.description: Write notes on how to keep the free-tier resources inexpensive.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Add advanced topics, polish your portfolio, and prepare for interviews or client pitches.

milestones.title: Monitoring and alerting basics
milestones.outcome: You can instrument services with Prometheus and set up Grafana dashboards.

tasks.title: Read Prometheus fundamentals on Prometheus.io
tasks.description: Focus on metrics exposition and scrape configs.

tasks.title: Install Prometheus and Node exporter via Docker
tasks.description: Run containers locally and verify metrics collection.

tasks.title: Create a Grafana dashboard for CPU and memory
tasks.description: Add panels that query Prometheus for host metrics.

tasks.title: Reflect on alert thresholds
tasks.description: Write a short plan for alerts that would indicate service degradation.

milestones.title: Advanced CI/CD with GitOps
milestones.outcome: You can manage deployments declaratively using Argo CD or Flux.

tasks.title: Watch Argo CD introduction on YouTube (official channel)
tasks.description: Understand the GitOps workflow and UI basics.

tasks.title: Install Argo CD on a local Kind cluster
tasks.description: Follow the official quick-start guide to deploy Argo CD via Helm.

tasks.title: Practice syncing a sample app repo
tasks.description: Create a Git repo with Kubernetes manifests and let Argo CD deploy it automatically.

tasks.title: Connect with a GitOps community Slack
tasks.description: Join the Argo CD Slack workspace and ask a question about best practices.

milestones.title: Interview and client readiness
milestones.outcome: You can articulate your projects, answer scenario questions, and negotiate contracts.

tasks.title: Write concise project summaries for each portfolio item
tasks.description: Create a one-page description highlighting problem, solution, tools, and results.

tasks.title: Practice answering common DevOps interview questions
tasks.description: Use the LeetCode Discuss DevOps thread to rehearse answers aloud.

tasks.title: Build a personal website to showcase projects
tasks.description: Deploy a static site on GitHub Pages linking to your repos and demos.

tasks.title: Reflect on salary and rate expectations
tasks.description: Research market rates on Glassdoor and note your target compensation.
